title: Program Links
description: Directed cross-program crediting (point conversions, elite-night credits, status matches). Mirrors `[ProgramLink]` in QualificationEngine/ProgramLink.swift. File convention: `*.links.json` (root is an array).

toMetricId.description: Destination metric the credit lands on. Empty for statusBenefit.

minNights.description: Minimum nights for a stay to qualify.

perNights.description: If set, credit per N-night block instead of flat per stay.

requiresPaidStay.description: Whether the stay must be paid to qualify (default true).

requiresTierIds.description: statusBenefit: source tier ids that grant the benefit.

grantsTierId.description: statusBenefit: destination tier id the match grants (display-only).
